results.text: Profound gastric mucosal changes and severe rebound acid hypersecretion after long-term Vonoprazan use: A case report. Vonoprazan is a novel acid blocker with greater potency than proton pump inhibitors. A Japanese study reported no significant safety concerns over 5 years of Vonoprazan use; however, elevated serum gastrin and increased parietal cell and foveolar hyperplasia were observed, and long-term safety data beyond 5 years are limited.
